rulings.citation: 2025 Brownlow Medal eligibility, Toby Greene: AFL Regulations effective 28 February 2025, reg. 21.2(c), 21.3-21.5. https://www.afl.com.au/news/1373677 ; https://www.afl.com.au/news/1427225

rulings.note: Tristan Xerri (7 votes): R18 striking Tom Sparrow, three matches: initial challenge 1365693; Tribunal outcome 1365899 upholds three matches and rejects the downgrade. Ruling: Ineligible; qualifying reportable offence, suspension upheld.

rulings.note: Zac Bailey (6 votes): R18 rough conduct against Nick Haynes, one match: MRO 1361425; Tribunal outcome 1365899 rejects the attempted reduction to low impact/a fine. Ruling: Ineligible; financial-only exception does not apply.

rulings.note: Rory Laird (5 votes): R22 rough conduct against Jamie Cripps, one match: initial challenge 1388030; Tribunal 1388249 rejects it. R24 follow-up confirms return from that suspension. Ruling: Ineligible; the later R24 fine does not undo the R22 suspension.

rulings.citation: 2025 Brownlow Medal eligibility, Sam Durham: AFL Regulations effective 28 February 2025, reg. 21.2(c), 21.3-21.5. https://www.afl.com.au/news/1339570 ; https://www.afl.com.au/news/1339726/medical-room-the-full-afl-injury-list-r14/amp ; https://www.afl.com.au/news/1354977/medical-room-the-full-afl-injury-list-r17
rulings.note: Sam Durham (4 votes): R13 forceful front-on contact against Adam Cerra, two matches offered: 1339570. R14 follow-up 1339726 lists suspension/return R17; R17 follow-up 1354977 confirms return from suspension. No overturn is evidenced; the actual absence corroborates the sanction. Ruling: Ineligible; subsequent reports establish a served suspension, not merely an offered charge.

rulings.citation: 2025 Brownlow Medal eligibility, Dan Houston: AFL Regulations effective 28 February 2025, reg. 21.2(c), 21.3-21.5. https://www.afl.com.au/news/1292232 ; https://www.afl.com.au/news/1305410/medical-room-the-full-afl-injury-list-r7/amp
rulings.note: Dan Houston (3 votes): R4 rough conduct against Lachie Fogarty, two matches: 1292232. R7 follow-up 1305410 confirms he served the two-game suspension. Ruling: Ineligible for the 2025 offence; no reliance on the separate 2024 ban carried over.

rulings.citation: 2025 Brownlow Medal eligibility, Dylan Shiel: AFL Regulations effective 28 February 2025, reg. 21.2(c), 21.3-21.5. https://www.afl.com.au/news/1383983 ; https://www.afl.com.au/news/1388249/the-verdict-is-in-essendon-bombers-veteran-dylan-shiel-learns-his-fate-at-tribunal ; https://www.afl.com.au/news/1396186/medical-room-the-full-afl-injury-list-r24/amp
rulings.note: Dylan Shiel (3 votes): R22 shove of Mark O'Connor causing Luamon Lual's fall: referral 1383983 proposed one match; Tribunal 1388249 imposes one match for rough conduct. R24 follow-up confirms availability after suspension. Ruling: Ineligible; the Tribunal rejected the defence that injury to a teammate fell outside the rule.

rulings.citation: 2025 Brownlow Medal eligibility, Patrick Voss: AFL Regulations effective 28 February 2025, reg. 21.2(c), 21.3-21.5. https://www.afl.com.au/news/1300207 ; https://www.afl.com.au/news/1300516
rulings.note: Patrick Voss (3 votes): R5 striking Nick Vlastuin, three matches: initial challenge 1300207; Tribunal 1300516 rejects reducing severe impact to high and leaves all three matches in place. Ruling: Ineligible; qualifying suspension upheld.

rulings.citation: 2025 Brownlow Medal eligibility, Liam Baker: AFL Regulations effective 28 February 2025, reg. 21.2(c), 21.3-21.5. https://www.afl.com.au/news/1401221 ; https://www.afl.com.au/news/1403587
rulings.note: Liam Baker (2 votes): R24 rough conduct against Chad Warner, one match: challenge 1401221; Tribunal 1403587 rejects the impact downgrade. Ban to be served in 2026. Ruling: Ineligible in 2025 under 21.2(c), because the offence occurred in the 2025 H&A match. This does not transfer any 2026 ownership.

rulings.note: Ollie Wines (2 votes): R23 rough conduct against Cooper Lord, three matches: 1393572; Tribunal 1396382 rejects reducing severe impact to high and upholds three matches. Ruling: Ineligible for the 2025 offence, regardless of carry-over service.

rulings.citation: 2025 Brownlow Medal eligibility, Shannon Neale: AFL Regulations effective 28 February 2025, reg. 21.2(c), 21.3-21.5. https://www.afl.com.au/news/1396161/match-review-big-geelong-cat-shannon-neale-banned-for-high-bump ; https://www.afl.com.au/news/1398164/geelong-cats-coach-chris-scott-left-doubly-surprised-by-tribunals-bump-call
rulings.note: Shannon Neale (2 votes): R23 rough conduct/high bump against Jake Lloyd, one match offered: 1396161. The later Scott follow-up 1398164, read directly, confirms the Cats did not appeal and Neale would miss Richmond. Davies' separate successful downgrade did not change Neale's sanction. Ruling: Ineligible; qualifying one-match suspension stood without an appeal.
